evidence: Changes src/index/txindex.cpp, src/index/txindex.h, and introduces tx_lookup_result.h to allow txindex to operate under block pruning.
rationale: Resolves four long-standing user feature requests dating back to 2017 (#10609, #12651, #16182, #35240) by allowing -txindex to run on pruned nodes. Reviewers noted this is a major improvement that significantly expands the capability of pruned nodes.
